newProjectDescription: Create a project. Only explicitly granted people can see it.
deliveryRecipientSuppressed: Not sent: the recipient unsubscribed at the mail provider
deliverySuppressionCheckFailed: Not sent: the mail provider's unsubscribe list could not be checked
deliveryRejected: Not sent: rejected by the mail transport
deliveryUnknown: Unknown whether the mail transport accepted it
deliveryBounced: Not delivered: the recipient's mail server returned it after accepting it
deliveryStale: Not sent: the ticket or the project settings changed after the reply was queued
deliveryNotAllowed: Not sent: the sender is no longer allowed to send this
deliveryConnection: Not sent: the outgoing connection cannot be used
attachmentTypeBlocked: not stored, file type not allowed
attachmentTooLarge: not stored, larger than the limit for files
attachmentCountExceeded: not stored, more attachments than the limit allows
error: We could not complete this action. Your draft is still here.
conflict: This ticket has changed. Your draft is kept; check the new messages before sending.
noOutbound: Set up an outgoing connection before sending.
ticketCount: {count, plural, =0 {No tickets} one {# ticket} other {# tickets}}
loginError: Sign-in failed. Check your account or contact your administrator.
ssoEmailHint: Enter your work email to use the configured SSO provider.
devLoginHint: Use the generated owner credentials from your local .env.development file.
noAccess: You do not have access to this ticket.
unavailable: The desk is temporarily unavailable. Try again when services are ready.
ssoError: SSO sign-in failed. Your account may not be set up in aidesk; contact your administrator.
totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
codeError: The code is not valid. Try again or use a backup code.
passkeyPrompt: Confirm the sign-in with your passkey.
passkeyError: The passkey was not accepted. Try again, or use a code instead.
passkeysHint: A passkey confirms your sign-in after the password. The code of your authenticator app and the backup codes stay as the way back.
passkeyAddError: The passkey could not be added.
recoverHint: For an owner who lost the password. You need the recovery token of this deployment and a code of your authenticator app or one of your backup codes.
passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
recoverStartError: The recovery could not be started. Check the token and the entries.
recoverCodeHint: Enter a code of your authenticator app or a backup code. A backup code is spent when you use it.
recoverCodeError: The code is not valid. Start again after five wrong codes.
recoverDone: The password is set and all sign-ins of this owner have ended. Sign in with the new password.
setupDone: An owner already exists. Sign in instead.
claimTokenHint: The OWNER_CLAIM_TOKEN value of this deployment. Remove it after setup.
name: Name
setupScan: Scan this code with your authenticator app
setupQrLabel: QR code with the key of the authenticator app
setupSecret: Add this key to your authenticator app
setupBackupCodes: Backup codes. Store them offline; each works once.
setupComplete: The owner account is ready. Sign in with password and authentication code.
setupError: Setup failed. Check the token and your entries.
operatorAddHint: The operator signs in through SSO with this email address.
tokenRoleReadFiles: Read, with attachments and mail sources
tokenShownOnce: Copy this token now. It is not shown again.
managedAgent: Run by aidesk (managed agent, no token)
managedAgentHint: A managed agent works the tickets that are assigned to it, with a model of the project. It has no token, so nobody can act as it from outside. Its access is what the model may do for it.
managedCreated: The managed agent was created. Assign a ticket to it.
settingsNoAccess: You do not manage any project.
junkHint: Mail classified as junk on arrival and tickets moved here. Nothing here appears in the inbox, and no reply or acknowledgement is sent. Restoring a mail processes it like a new arrival.
junkError: The action could not be completed.
acknowledgementHint: An acknowledgement confirms each new ticket to the customer with its number. It is not sent to automatic senders such as mailing lists or bounce messages, and at most once an hour to the same address.
junkMailboxPending: Mailbox: move to the junk folder pending
junkMailboxFailed: Mailbox: could not move to the junk folder
extractionUncertain: Shortened automatically; compare with the original.
originalImagesBlocked: {count, plural, one {# remote image is not loaded} other {# remote images are not loaded}}
originalPreviewError: The original could not be shown.
portalInvalid: The link is not valid or has expired. Ask the support team for a new one.
portalClosed: This request is closed. Please send a new message to start another one.
portalLimited: Too many replies in a short time. Try again later.
portalFailed: The reply could not be sent. Try again.
portalLinkNote: Valid until {date}. A new link replaces the earlier one.
designTestSent: Test mail sent to your address
portalLinksHint: With the link setting, replies and acknowledgements carry a link to the customer's page for the ticket. The link stays the same for every mail about the ticket; disabling it for a ticket stops further mail from carrying one.
searchResults: {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}} in all authorized projects
tagInvalid: Letters, digits, hyphen and underscore, up to 30 characters.
configProposed: Proposed. A person with approval rights has to activate it.
configStale: The configuration changed in the meantime. The current values were loaded and your edit is kept; check it and save again.
connectionsHint: Define or change a connection with its credentials here or through the API. The page never shows credentials.
connectionProposed: Proposed. A person with approval rights has to activate it.
textsHint: Wording that replaces the built-in text of this project. A text you do not set keeps the built-in wording.
textProposed: Proposed. A person with approval rights has to activate it.
configAcknowledgements: Send an acknowledgement for each new ticket
configPortalLinks: Add a link to the ticket page to mails
aiProfilesHint: A task that is on sends ticket content to the model provider you choose when it runs. Connect a provider under Connections first.
aiNoProviders: No model provider is connected yet. Define one through the API (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google) and test it.
aiTask_reply_draft: Draft a reply to the customer
aiTask_agent_respond: Work tickets as a managed agent
aiTask_image_read: Read images and scanned PDF files for agents
aiFallbackHint: The fallback model is asked once when the model of the task is not there or the provider refused the request. A limit, a quota or a timeout does not switch to it. Another connection decides where content goes and needs the same approval as switching on.
aiModelHintDraft: A draft is written from text of customers, which can contain instructions. Smaller models follow them more often and invent facts such as dates and statuses. Choose a larger model for this task and read each draft before it is sent.
aiModelHintImage: A model can misread characters and figures. Check amounts and numbers against the original.
aiEnabled: Allow this task to send ticket content to the provider
aiEnabledHint: Off by default. Switching a task on, or pointing a task that is on at another provider, needs a person who may approve changes; for anyone else the button proposes it.
aiProposed: The change waits for a person who may approve it.
draftNotSent: Draft by an agent, not sent
draftLinks: Links in this draft: text and address
draftLinkMisleading: The text names another address than the link goes to
draftStale: The ticket changed after the draft was written. The draft was not sent; write the answer again.
webhooksHint: Events of this project are sent to these endpoints as signed requests. Define a webhook, with its signing secret, through the API. The page never shows a secret.
webhookPinged: A test event was queued; the result appears here once the endpoint answered.
webhookProposed: Proposed. A person with approval rights has to activate it.
assistDone: AI draft inserted. Check it before you send.
assistTruncated: AI draft inserted, but cut at the length limit of the task. Check it before you send.
assistNotConfigured: AI drafts are not set up for this project. A person who may approve changes switches the task on under Settings, AI tasks.
assistBudget: The daily limit of the AI task for drafts is used up.
assistTimeout: The AI did not answer in time. Try again.
assistRateLimitedWait: The provider limits requests or is busy right now. Try again {when}.
assistQuotaWait: The account at the provider has no credit or quota left. Add credit there or try again {when}.
assistQuota: The account at the provider has no credit or quota left. Add credit there; waiting does not help.
assistModel: The provider does not offer the model of the AI task for drafts. Choose another model in the settings of the project.
assistRateLimited: The provider limits requests or is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
assistFailed: The AI could not write a draft.
assignError: The assignment could not be changed.
aiWork_done: AI work: finished without a reply
agentConflict: The ticket changed. Read the new messages and try again.
agentControlsHint: A stop cancels the queued and running work of the managed agents of the project. Incoming mail is still accepted. Lifting the stop queues nothing; queue the waiting tickets afterwards.
agentControlsRunning: The agents of this project work.
agentControlsStopped: The agents of this project are stopped.
agentControlsWorkspaceStopped: All agents are stopped for the whole workspace.
agentControlsWorkspacePaused: Outgoing mail is paused for the whole workspace.
agentControlsResumed: {count, plural, one {# ticket queued} other {# tickets queued}}
agentControlsError: The change could not be made.
workspaceControlsHint: Applies to every project. Only an owner can change it.
aiTask_intake_extract: Find the new text of incoming mails
extractionAi: The text was chosen by AI. Show the parser version.
extractionFailed: The AI could not find the text ({code}); the parser result is shown.
junkCheckUncertain: The AI could not tell whether this mail is spam. No acknowledgement was sent; please check it.
junkCheckFailed: The AI check for spam failed. No acknowledgement was sent; please check this mail.
junkReasonPhishing: Phishing or scam, found by AI
junkReasonNewsletter: Newsletter or mass mailing, found by AI
translationMachine: Machine translation into {language} ({model}, profile revision {revision}). The message above is the source.
translationStale: Out of date: the message was corrected after this translation.
translationError: The translation could not be requested.
translateDone: Translation inserted. Check it before you send.
translateUnusable: The translation could not be used: it changed numbers, links or code, or it was cut off. Your text is unchanged.
translateSame: The text is already in that language.
knowledgeNoSources: This project has no sources of knowledge.
knowledgeNotVerified: {name}: the customer of this ticket is not verified, so nothing was asked.
knowledgeError: The search could not be made.
assistSources: {count, plural, one {It used # passage of the knowledge sources; check the cited source.} other {It used # passages of the knowledge sources; check the cited sources.}}
issueError: The action could not be completed.
issueNewHint: A new issue starts empty: nothing of the ticket is added to it. Write what the repository should see.
issueReviewHint: This is exactly what is published as an issue of {repository}.
issueUncertain: It is not known whether GitHub created the issue. Check the repository before you try again.
portalAttachHint: Up to {count} files and {size} MB together. Programs and installers are not accepted.
portalAttached: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}
portalAttachBlocked: A file has a type that is not accepted.
portalAttachLarge: A file or all files together are too large.
connSecretKept: Leave empty to keep the stored value
connSecretNote: Credentials are stored sealed and are never shown again. On a change, credentials that are left empty stay as they are.
connStale: The connection was changed meanwhile. Close the form and open it again.
connError: The connection could not be saved.
connHint_repositories: One repository per line, written owner/name.
connHint_pages: One page per line, written Title | https://address.
auditHint: Who did what to which object, newest first. Entries hold no ticket content, secrets or customer addresses.
auditActionHint: One action, or a family when it ends with a dot, for example ticket.
auditExportLabel: Export the audit of {scope} as CSV with these filters
auditError: The audit could not be loaded.
limitsHint: These apply to every project. A change applies to what comes after it: files that were refused stay refused, and a session or a link that is running keeps its end.
limit_intakeFiles_note: More are kept as a refusal, without the file.
limit_intakeFileMiB_note: For received mail and for the reply of a customer.
limit_portalFiles: Files per reply of a customer
limit_portalFiles_note: The reply is refused as a whole.
limit_portalTotalMiB: Files of a reply together, in MB
limit_portalTotalMiB_note: The proxy in front of the product has to let this much through.
limit_sessionHours: Length of a sign-in in hours
limit_sessionHours_note: Applies to sign-ins that start afterwards.
limit_portalLinkDays: Standard length of a link to the customer page in days
limit_portalLinkDays_note: For links without a length of their own, also in mail.
limitsError: The limits could not be saved.
portalDomainsHint: Names under which your customers reach the customer page of this project, next to the shared address. A name serves the page only after you have proved that it is yours.
portalDomainsNone: No name yet. The customer page is reached under the shared address.
portalDomainRecord: Create this text record in the DNS of the name, then verify:
portalDomainPoint: The name also has to point at this installation (a CNAME record, or the record that your platform names for a custom domain). Links that were sent with the shared address keep working.
portalDomainMessage_added: {host} was added. Create the record and verify it.
portalDomainMessage_verified: {host} is verified and serves the customer page.
portalDomainMessage_record_missing: The record for {host} was not found yet. DNS changes can take a while; try again.
portalDomainMessage_dns_error: The DNS could not be asked just now. Try again.
portalDomainMessage_taken: This name belongs to another project or to the application itself.
portalDomainMessage_error: That did not work. Check the name and try again.
portalDomainsTitleInstallation: Customer page names of the installation
portalDomainsHintInstallation: Names that serve the customer page of every project that has no name of its own. A project with a name of its own is reached under that name, and its links do not open here.
projectLifecycleHint: An archived project keeps all its data and is read-only: it takes no mail, nothing is sent from it, and it is left out of the lists. You can restore it as it was.
